package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for request_dto_outside_transport_package: Request binding structs that live in repositories or service packages instead of transport-facing packages.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type UserService struct {
	repo *UserRepository
}

type UserRepository struct{}

type SignupInput struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
	Email    string `json:"email"`
	Role     string `json:"role"`
}

func (s *UserService) CreateUserFromInput(input SignupInput) error {
	return s.repo.Insert(input.Username, input.Password, input.Email)
}

func SignupHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var input SignupInput
	json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&input)

	svc := &UserService{}
	svc.CreateUserFromInput(input)

	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"result": "ok"})
}
